_note: THE DUNGEON RETURN, a new type: raiders took a homesteader's things into a dungeon; you take her bag back off
whoever leads them, carry it home and hand it to her in a conversation. His idea, 2026-10-12; words Jessica's.
BUILT 2026-10-13 on his "11a" (Eliza), the two pieces this recipe asked for:
1. A DUNGEON main place: beat 1 sits on LocDungeonBossLocRef, and that marker does the selecting, as vanilla's
MB_Bounty01Far asks a place for it and nothing else (his screenshot, 2026-10-13). POIs carry it too (his: "loads
of pois have mapmarkers and boss markers"), so the lint measures the POI pool plus every boss-marker location.
The boss marker is indoors only ~29% of the time, so the holder may stand outside; his play settles which.
2. The talk is the whole last step, so it is the HAND-BACK: exchange 0's reply sets stage 100, which takes the
Homesteader's Bag and completes. Exchanges 1 to 3 loop in any order.
The base's two object slots are unused here (neither beat has an object), so the build removes them rather than
leave a marker alias the dungeon cannot fill.

place._theme: A dungeon there; a quiet non-hostile site here for her to be waiting at (she is placed, rule 2). One peopled end only, so the pool cost of rule 4 does not apply.

prose.name: Recovery: Stolen Belongings on <Planet>
prose.briefing: Raiders cleaned out a homesteader's place and took everything to the <Place>. She says they can keep most of it. She wants her bag back.

beats.objective: Recover the stolen belongings from the <Place>
beats.journal: The raider leading them at the <Place> had the homesteader's bag. I took it back. She's waiting at the <SecondPlace>.

beats.objective: Return the bag to the homesteader at the <SecondPlace>
beats.journal: Raiders took a homesteader's things to the <Place>. I went in after them, got her bag back and returned it. She said they could keep the credits.

person.name: Petra Hollis
hellos: Oh. Hello. Sorry, I'm a bit on edge today.

greeting: Sorry. I've been weeding all morning, it's the only thing that keeps me calm.
You've got that look. Did you actually go in there?

reply: They took my money as well, and I don't care. You can't buy back what's in here.
Anything that wasn't bolted down. Stuff comes back.
Nothing anyone would steal on purpose.
Old photos, a hat, and a book I've read nine times. They took it because it was there.
Anything that'll put up with me.
Beans, mostly. Beans are very forgiving.

beats._talk: Exchange 0 is the hand-back: it ends the conversation, takes the Homesteader's Bag and sets stage 100, which pays 'reward'. Voiced lines: no names, no places (radio rules). The same voice as the radio speaker.
beats._greeting: 2026-10-23, his play: "the growing line is unprompted. It's a fine line just nothing sets it up." 'What do you grow?' was set up only by a hello, which may not be the one that plays; the greeting always plays before the menu, so the weeding goes there.

broadcast: I don't care about most of it. There's a bag, though.
If anyone's going in there, I'd like the bag back.
_speech: Her own voice on the radio, and the same voice for Petra in person (ElevenLabs 'Isla', Scottish, chill; NOT heard in game, his ear decides). No names, no places.
